name: Friendly Voices Phone Buddies for Seniors
description: Weekly volunteer phone calls offering supportive listening and confidentiality for isolated seniors age 60+
fullDescription: Friendly Voices, now part of the older-adult nonprofit Avenidas, connects isolated seniors age 60+ in the San Francisco Bay Area and beyond with a trained volunteer phone buddy for weekly friendly conversations, reducing loneliness and providing social connection.
whatTheyOffer:
- Weekly volunteer phone calls
- Supportive listening
- Confidential, HIPAA-compliant calls
- Matched 1:1 with the same phone buddy over many months
- Cantonese, Hindi, or Mandarin-speaking volunteers on request
- Free service for seniors 60+
howToGetIt:
1. Visit Friendly Voices website
2. Click "Sign Up an Older Adult" (seniors, family, or caregivers can sign up)
3. Complete the sign-up form
4. Get matched with a screened, trained volunteer buddy
5. Receive weekly phone calls
6. Build ongoing friendship
keywords: Friendly Voices, senior phone calls, loneliness, isolated, homebound, volunteer buddy, 60+, social connection
